migrations.risk: additive new table + indexes + idempotent backfill INSERT; no existing columns modified; backfill WHERE NOT EXISTS is safe to re-run; workspace_id NOT NULL is satisfied via COALESCE for pre-cutover NULL rows
migrations.rollbackPlan: DROP TABLE resources; the attachments table is untouched so the legacy read path is unaffected. The resources action file can be removed or feature-flagged before the drop. No schema change to existing tables is rolled back.
postconditions: resources kind CHECK constraint allows only upload and link
upload-kind resources count equals attachments count (backfill complete)
